item.title: City council approves $210M transit expansion after marathon session
item.description: After a six-hour session and more than sixty public comments, the council voted 7–2 to approve the largest transit package in city history, funding three rapid-bus corridors & a light-rail extension.

item.title: Chipmaker posts record quarter as AI demand surges
item.description: Data-center orders drove revenue up 42% year over year, and the company raised its full-year outlook for the second time this year, citing sustained AI infrastructure buildout across every region it serves worldwide, with analysts noting the growth streak now spans six consecutive quarters.
